New: the band where the original fails is exactly {q < r < p <= sqrt(r^3/q)}, non-empty precisely when q < r, and on the campaign's line (p,1,2) it is 2 < p <= 2 sqrt 2. Have your own plan BEFORE reading the prior attempts printed at claim time; then either build on a refereed partial result or take a different route.
